technical_and_design_decisions: Extend the Spring Cloud Stream binder infrastructure to support multiple named binder configurations for the same binding type (e.g., multiple RabbitMQ or Kafka clusters).
Update the Spring XD HDFS custom module resolution logic to properly construct NameNode HA proxies using Hadoop Configuration and URI utility methods instead of non-HA proxies.
Refactor and port the existing Cassandra Sink module from Spring XD into a standalone Spring Cloud Stream app starter with Spring Boot auto-configuration.
Refactor and port the Analytic PMML Processor module from Spring XD into a standalone Spring Cloud Stream processor app starter using JPMML/PMML evaluation libraries.
Expose REST endpoints in Spring XD Admin UI backend to return job composition flags and composition graph representations (parent-child dependencies).

Update Spring XD UI / AngularJS frontend to consume job composition REST APIs, render visual indicators for composed jobs, and enable proper navigation links to detail pages for both singular and composed jobs.
assumptions: Development environment includes access to Java 17+, Hadoop test environment configured for NameNode HA, and relevant database/messaging middleware.
Spring XD Admin REST APIs and UI leverage existing Spring XD Admin infrastructure (AngularJS frontend and Spring MVC/Hateoas backend).
All work will be performed by a single developer responsible for implementation, unit testing, integration testing, and documentation.

activities.activity_description: Design and implement multi-binder support for identical binding types within Spring Cloud Stream / XD framework, allowing distinct target system configurations and dynamic binder routing.

activities.activity_name: HDFS NameNode HA Support for Custom Modules (U2)
activities.activity_description: Fix module resolution logic in XD to support HDFS NameNode High Availability configs when retrieving custom modules, replacing non-HA proxies with HA-aware NameNode proxies.

activities.activity_name: Port Cassandra Sink Module to Spring Cloud Stream (U3)
activities.activity_description: Migrate the Cassandra sink module from Spring XD into the spring-cloud-stream-app-starters repository, including auto-configuration, configuration properties, and integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Port Analytic PMML Processor Module to Spring Cloud Stream (U4)
activities.activity_description: Port the analytic-pmml processor module from Spring XD to spring-cloud-stream repository as a streaming processor, integrating PMML model execution and validation tests.

activities.activity_name: Job Composition REST API Endpoints (U5, U6)
activities.activity_description: Implement Spring XD Admin REST endpoints returning job composition flags and composition graphs (nodes and edges representing parent-child batch job relationships).

activities.activity_name: Job Composition UI Enhancements & Navigation (U7, U8)
activities.activity_description: Enhance Spring XD UI to visually differentiate composed workflows from single jobs and enable seamless navigation to job detail pages for both singular and composed job instances.
Perform end-to-end integration testing across multi-binder setups, HDFS HA custom module loading, ported s-c-s modules, and the job composition UI.
